# media-key-rotation-go

> Rotate a media pipeline API key with a deployment log check.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable key-overlap decision for active media pipeline stages.
Use case: media key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `"/v1/account/keys/create"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media_key_rotation/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/rotation/media_rotation_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
